description: Recheck the calling tenant's registered records in one space against their writers' PDSes, on a fresh delegation. The tenant's answer to a `remote.recheck_requested` webhook.

main.description: A space credential lasts ten minutes, so Antiphony's hourly sweep never holds one: it asks the tenant, and the tenant answers here with a fresh delegation token from any member session that can read the space. Antiphony spends it at once and reads each due row: an unchanged one is noted (and a pushed one becomes `verified: "fetched"`), an edited one is taken and reprocessed (`remote.changed`), and a gone one is removed once a second read an hour later agrees (`remote.gone`). A deleted space reads as gone for every row. One call reads a bounded number of rows; `remaining` says to call again with another delegation. Tenant-level: a service token is enough, no acting actor.

space.description: The space, as a space URI: at://{authority}/space/{type}/{skey}.

delegationToken.description: A fresh delegation token (a compact JWS) from a member who can read the space. Single use.

clientAttestation.description: A client attestation from the tenant's OAuth client, for a space that only admits listed apps.

removed.description: Rows removed because their record, or the whole space, is gone.

remaining.description: Whether rows in this space are still due: call again with another delegation.

errors.name: RemoteUriUnsupported
errors.description: `space` is not a space URI Antiphony can read.

errors.name: RemoteDelegationRefused
errors.description: The space's authority refused the delegation; nothing changed.

errors.name: RemoteRepoUnreachable
errors.description: The space's authority could not be reached; nothing changed. Retry with a fresh delegation.

errors.name: RemoteRecordInvalid
errors.description: The space's authority could not be read as a space host.
